title: Geologic map of the Saylors Lake quadrangle, Calhoun, Lexington, and Richland Counties, South Carolina
citation: Shelley, D.C., 2007, Geologic map of the Saylors Lake quadrangle, Calhoun, Lexington, and Richland Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-38, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet with interleaved columns. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 20) read from page image tiles: 12 holes with unit intervals as elevations read off the feet scale (+/-2 ft, inferred). Holes drawn wholly above the profile in extrapolated (dashed, eroded) contacts are left out (32-335, 09-215, 09-220, 09-219, 09-218, 09-227), as is 09-247 on the section (drawn from above the profile; its text log is recorded as an observation) and 09-240. No horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points. General references (Georgia dunes, Carolina bays, LIDAR data, Mississippi valley) skipped.
